exchanges: back from nights, three down one to go
One more and then a break. How was tonight?
fine actually. kofi was in charge and he runs a calm ward
A calm lead makes the whole night easier.
he's off to Accra next week for his dad's birthday so it's someone else after that
Hopefully his cover is as steady.
fingers crossed. felix is packing boxes in the hallway, i had to climb over them
Is he moving out?
yeah he got a job in Berlin, leaves in a month
That is a big move.
we need a new flatmate now, amara is already writing a list of rules
A list of rules might save arguments later.
she's in her final year of pharmacology so she wants someone quiet
Makes sense with exams coming.
also she has yoga every Friday at 6am and does not want anyone crashing in at that time
Early yoga needs a quiet flat.
i do boxing on Monday so i get it, nobody wants to be tired for that
Sounds like a good way to let off steam.
it really is. i'm terrible at it though
Everyone starts somewhere.
my cousin nadia came to watch once and laughed the whole time
Family can be harsh critics.
she's a musician, she plays cello in some orchestra up north
That must take a lot of practice.
and my neighbour, also called nadia, plays trombone in a brass band, so the street is very musical
Two musical Nadias, quite a coincidence.
lol yes. i should practise something other than crochet
Making things with your hands still counts.
i'm making a blanket for my aunt ingrid, she grew up in Bergen so she's picky about wool
She will appreciate the work then.
it's taking forever though
Big projects usually do.
i have a gp appointment on Wednesday about my wrist
Good that you are getting it checked.
it's been clicking since i lifted a patient wrong
Lifting injuries are common on wards.
oh i need to fix something, felix isn't going to berlin, it's Hamburg, berlin was just where he interviewed
Thanks for clearing that up.
he says hamburg is cheaper anyway
That will help with the move.
i live in Leytonstone and even that's getting expensive
Rents are rising everywhere.
i drive an old Fiesta to work because the night buses are awful
Driving is probably safer at those hours.
it makes a weird noise when it's cold
Worth getting it looked at before winter.
yeah when i have money lol
Fair.
i'm hungry but too tired to cook
Something simple might be enough.
katsu curry is my favourite but that's not happening at this hour
Save it for a day off.
true. i'll make toast
Toast it is.
amara just came in, she got offered a placement at Pfizer!
Good news for her.
wait what instrument did my cousin play again
ok i'm going to sleep, alarm set for 6pm
Sleep well.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your cousin Nadia plays the cello.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your cousin Nadia plays the trombone.
